Description: Absence of authorized penalty weight ratio between fuel (L) and unmet load (kWh)
Current Implementation State: 16000:1 objective coefficient ratio ($10000/kWh penalty vs $0.625/kWh fuel)
Documented Requirement State: Qualitative requirement to minimize fuel and supply power reliably
Operational Impact: High: Drives extreme diesel dispatch under low forecast solar
Required Governance Action: Stakeholder authorization of penalty exchange rate ratio

Description: Absence of explicit numerical ceiling on unserved critical load
Current Implementation State: Soft objective penalty without hard bound or SLA cap
Documented Requirement State: Qualitative goal for zero shortage / continuous load service
Operational Impact: Medium: Allows load shedding when solver evaluates lower cost
Required Governance Action: Establish governed SLA / maximum unmet load ceiling (kWh)

Description: Absence of annual fuel target or liters ceiling for generator operations
Documented Requirement State: Qualitative mandate for lower fuel dependence
Operational Impact: Medium: Solver has no upper fuel volume constraint
Required Governance Action: Authorize formal numerical fuel target or annual fuel cap (L)

Description: Absence of multi-tier load classification and shedding sequence
Current Implementation State: Placeholder deferrable/curtailable load definitions in config
Operational Impact: Low to Medium: All unmet load penalized equally at $10000/kWh
Required Governance Action: Define formal multi-tier load priority hierarchy

Description: Absence of dynamic emergency BESS reserve floor above technical min SOC
Current Implementation State: Technical 20% min SOC used as absolute lower bound
Documented Requirement State: Qualitative requirement for emergency storage protection
Operational Impact: Medium: BESS can be discharged to 20% under normal dispatch
Required Governance Action: Establish explicit emergency BESS reserve floor (kWh or % SOC)

Description: Absence of governed terminal SOC constraint at end of 24h MPC horizon
Documented Requirement State: Qualitative intent for continuous sustainable operation
Operational Impact: Medium: BESS may be depleted at horizon end forcing generator start
Required Governance Action: Specify terminal SOC equality/inequality constraint for MPC horizon

Description: Absence of quantitative renewable integration target (%)
Documented Requirement State: Qualitative intent to maximize renewable integration
Operational Impact: Low: Solver prefers renewables over diesel when available
Required Governance Action: Establish formal renewable fraction target or curtailment cap

Description: Absence of stochastic/robust reserve buffers for forecast errors
Current Implementation State: Deterministic point forecasts used in horizon optimization
Operational Impact: High: EMS is vulnerable to unmodeled forecast errors
Required Governance Action: Authorize uncertainty margin policy or robust formulation

Description: Absence of limit on continuous consecutive hours of critical interruption
Documented Requirement State: Qualitative requirement to protect life support and heating
Operational Impact: High: Extended outages possible if physical deficit persists
Required Governance Action: Define maximum continuous critical load interruption limit (hours)

Description: Absence of hard daily or annual generator startup frequency cap
Documented Requirement State: Qualitative goal to optimize generator operations
Operational Impact: Low: Soft penalty discourages excessive cycling
Required Governance Action: Establish maximum allowable generator startup frequency cap
